newsitem.title: USA: Nichimen to resell Acacia switches.
newsitem.headline: Nichimen to resell Acacia switches.

text.p: Acacia Networks said Monday that Nichimen Corp has agreed to sell and service Acacia's NovaSwitch family of local area network switches in Japan.
Acacia said this master reseller relationship with Nichimen will yield more than one million dollars in sales during the rest of 1997, and could total as much as $5 million in 1998.

Nichimen will sell NovaSwitches under the Acacia name through its Nichimen Data Systems subsidiary, which will also provide technical support to Japanese end-users, value-added resellers and large-scale systems integrators.
The company said the Nichimen agreement is a major step in Acacia's strategy of developing a network of resellers in the Pacific Rim, North American and European markets.
